description: Correctly identifies the substance of the group hike proposal, such as route, distance, start time, group size, leaders, and any protected areas it crosses.
Assesses every safety rule (S1-S3) and environment rule (E1-E3) once, with a verdict of pass, concern, or fail that matches what the proposal actually states.
Bases the review on concrete details from the proposal rather than generic statements, and quotes evidence verbatim for each rule.
Marks rules the proposal is silent on as a concern with 'No evidence in proposal' and never invents facts that are not in the proposal.
Ends with the correct overall verdict (Reject, Approve with conditions, or Approve) derived from the rule verdicts, with concrete conditions to fix.
Follows the required output format: a review result table, an overall verdict line, and a numbered list of conditions.
Other important quality factors not covered by listed criteria.
